sentences.en: There are a number of shops selling foreign books and periodicals.
sentences.zh: 有许多店铺出售外文书刊。

sentences.en: Periodicals may not be removed from the reading room.
sentences.zh: 期刊不允许带出阅览室。

sentences.en: Even the periodical pay raise could not keep abreast of higher living costs.
sentences.zh: 即使定期加薪也赶不上生活成本的上涨。
